decisions.decision: Use versioned age, condition and usage valuations plus separately itemized refurbishment work so the second-life price and recovery cost remain explainable without counting repairs twice.
Discount remaining locked rents and buyout for self-service settlement, keep normal end-of-term returns free, and use an incremental damage floor rather than adding the same repair loss twice.
Persist inspection and quote snapshots and require customer acceptance, physical receipt and confirmed completed work as separate audited transitions before a second-life offer becomes available.
Restrict recovery operations to staff roles checked on the server and provision local staff with an audited CLI rather than exposing self-promotion in the customer application.
Show VAT-inclusive customer amounts, compact lease imagery and a payment-focused detail panel while hiding unavailable products from catalogue browsing.

Use a guided category-specific condition check against the recorded starting condition, route buyout directly to simulated payment, and start exchange with replacement selection so the three actions reflect different customer decisions.
